# HKU SPACE

> > Hong Kong University's School of Professional and Continuing Education offering diverse programmes, certificates, and short courses across professional development, lifestyle, and vocational training.

HKU SPACE (香港大學專業進修學院) provides part-time and full-time continuing education with support from the Continuing Education Fund (CEF). The institution operates multiple campuses including HKU SPACE Community College and HKU SPACE Po Leung Kuk Stanley Ho Community College, with locations in Admiralty and across Hong Kong Island.

## Key Topics

- Continuing Education Fund (CEF)
- HKU SPACE Community College
- HKU SPACE Po Leung Kuk Stanley Ho Community College
- Applied Learning Courses
- Professional Development
- Psychology & Counselling
- Culinary Arts & Gourmet Cooking
- Pet Care Programmes
- Payment Methods (繳費靈, VISA, Mastercard, 微信支付, 支付寶, 轉數快)
- Part-time and Full-time Study
- Certificate Programmes
- Short Courses
- Adverse Weather Arrangements
- Admiralty Campus

## Academic Programmes

- [Psychology & Counselling Programmes and Short Courses](http://hkuspace.hku.hk/interest/social-sciences/psychology-and-counselling): Psychology and counselling programmes with CEF support available
- [Certificate in Restorative and Grooming Techniques for the Deceased](http://hkuspace.hku.hk/prog/cert-for-module-fundamentals-of-restorative-and-grooming-techniques-for-the-deceased): Certificate in restorative and grooming techniques for deceased care

## Hospitality & Lifestyle Courses

- [Chocolatier Certificate: From Cocoa to Creation](http://hkuspace.hku.hk/prog/cert-for-module-chocolatier-essentials-from-cocoa-to-creation): Chocolatier certificate: cocoa bean to bar chocolate making techniques
- [Workshop on European Bridal Floral Decorations](http://hkuspace.hku.hk/prog/workshop-on-european-bridal-floral-decorations): European bridal floral design workshop covering bouquets and decorations
- [Pet Care Programmes and Short Courses](http://hkuspace.hku.hk/interest/hospitality-and-lifestyle/pet-care): Pet care programmes and short courses for part-time and full-time study

## Student Support & Information

- [Adverse Weather Arrangements](http://hkuspace.hku.hk/teaching-and-learning/learners-support/learners-information/special-weather-arrangements): Weather-related class cancellation policies for typhoons and rainstorms
